component.title: ProgressiveImage
component.purpose: A reserved, responsive image surface with restrained arrival and useful failure.

states.description: A loaded image is named and revealed without popping.
The reserved frame communicates loading without changing layout.
A failed request becomes a legible recovery surface.

claims.statement: The image is contained by an AspectRatio frame before the resource resolves.
The image preserves native alt naming and the error surface announces failure without relying on color alone.
